lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fifty years after the Hollow King fell, the elf who helped end him came back down the old south road.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: The road used to bend left here. Either it moved, or the river did.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: ...Or I'm thinking of a different road. That happens.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: There's a cottage. Smoke from the chimney. Someone's home.
